evidence.why: Shows status accumulation, exact exit conditions, input-specific sound, state transition and guarded cleanup.
Shows state-3 dispatch after the cooldown guard.

facts.rationale: Corrects the implication that the status condition must persist for consecutive updates and makes the exceptional global/zero-status exit explicit. The body has no counter reset for a zero status sample.
facts.value: Services Gallery movie playback when dispatched from state 3. After updating the MTH player, it increments the byte counter unk1 for each nonzero lbMthp_8001F604 result without resetting the counter on zero results. It returns the scene to state 1 when any controller trigger matches mask 0x1300, the accumulated counter exceeds 50, or gmMainLib_8046B0F0.xC is nonzero while the movie-status result is zero. It restores the menu-camera path on exit and, when unk0 marks an active movie, stops playback, restores menu audio, clears the active flag and counter, and destroys/nulls the movie-rendering GObj. Only controller-triggered exits play the Back sound.

evidence.why: Registration as a separate scheduled process.

facts.rationale: Adds a useful semantic name for the independent controller process that handles cooldown, selection, confirmation and Back, and delegates active movie servicing. This is a descriptive hypothesis, not recovery of an original symbol.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes the parent model's entrance/exit frame and teardown controller from input processing and cursor updates. The name describes observed behavior without claiming an original spelling.
